name: w1yjzn-google-account
goal: Prove Google sign-in gates Hub, macOS and iOS, enrolls revocable owner devices with PKCE, and preserves explicit code recovery.

evidence: Feature specification defines the three gates, PKCE exchange, recovery, device revocation, Tracker ownership and release boundary.
Implemented Hub device enrolment and revocation, system-browser desktop loopback and iOS ASWebAuthenticationSession, mandatory sign-in gates, and typed-code recovery.
